title: Design: A/R Summary PDF heading 91 And Over stays on one line
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The report has customers with amounts in every bucket on today's date.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Summary is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Download the PDF from the ⋯ menu and open it at 100%.
  2. Read the bucket headings, letter for letter.
  3. Look at the last bucket heading.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the PDF opens.
  • Step 2: "Current", "1-30 Days", "31-60 Days", "61-90 Days", "91 And Over", as on screen.
  • Step 3: "91 And Over" is on one line, not wrapped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R7: “The A/R and A/P Summary PDF and CSV head the last bucket column "91 And Over", exactly as the screen shows it; in the PDF the heading stays on one line.”
